analyst.summary: Anupam Rasayan's headline 65% revenue growth looks impressive but appears to be substantially a base-effect from a large recent capacity expansion rather than a genuine demand step-change, and the underlying cash-conversion cycle has stretched dramatically (111 to 377 days) alongside a low, roughly 6-7% return on equity. At 81-84 times trailing earnings, we do not see this rich a multiple justified by the underlying return and cash-conversion profile, and recommend keeping this a Sell.
